paragraphs.en: In {addition}, I have an old two-volume copy of the Shorter Oxford Dictionary , picked up a few years {ago} in a {bookshop} {sale} for just 99 {pence}.Of course, with its 2,672 pages, it's not exactly short.It contains {around} 163,000 words, {plus} word {combination} and idiomatic {phrase}.I don't often use this dictionary.However, if I need to {check} the {origin} of a word or to {look} up {example} of its {usage}, there's nothing better.

paragraphs.en: For well over a hundred years the most {influential} English dictionary was Samuel Johnson's A Dictionary of the English Language published in 1755.“To make dictionaries is {dull} work,”wrote Johnson, {illustrate} one definition of “dull”.But a dictionary can be a {pleasure} to read.A few minutes spent {cast} your eye over a page or two can be a {rewarding} {experience} .
